# Cleveland Clinic Health Essentials

> > Evidence-based health information and clinical guidance from Cleveland Clinic experts covering conditions, nutrition, mental health, and preventive care.

Cleveland Clinic Health Essentials is a patient-focused health information resource providing evidence-based clinical guidance on common health conditions, preventive care, and wellness topics. The site features content from Cleveland Clinic physicians, specialists, and registered dietitians to help patients understand symptoms, treatment options, and lifestyle modifications.

## Key Topics

- Cancer prevention and care
- Mental health and stress management
- Digestive and colorectal health
- Nutrition and diet
- Cold, flu, and respiratory illnesses
- Allergies and symptom management
- Skin care and dermatology
- Breast cancer
- Chronic conditions
- Home remedies and treatment
- Cancer screening
- Anxiety and panic disorder
- Symptom comparison guides
- Cleveland Clinic experts

## Health Conditions & Guides

- [Mental Health - Cleveland Clinic](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/health-conditions/mental-health): Mental health conditions guide covering stress management and anxiety
- [Digestive - Cleveland Clinic](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/health-conditions/digestive-health): Digestive health conditions guide covering gallbladder and acid reflux
- [Cold, Flu & Respiratory Illnesses - Cleveland Clinic](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/health-conditions/cold-flu-respiratory-illnesses): Respiratory illness guide covering cold, flu, RSV and immune health
- [Allergies - Cleveland Clinic](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/health-conditions/allergies): Comprehensive allergies guide with symptom management and prevention
- [Skin Care & Beauty - Cleveland Clinic](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/health-conditions/skin-care-beauty): Dermatology guide covering skin care, acne, aging and skin cancer

## Cancer Care & Prevention

- [Cancer Care & Prevention - Cleveland Clinic](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/health-conditions/cancer-care-prevention): Comprehensive guide to cancer care, prevention and risk reduction
- [Breast Cancer Questions for Your Doctor](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/breast-cancer-questions): Preparation guide with questions for oncologists about breast cancer
- [How Safe Are Colonoscopies?](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/are-colonoscopies-safe): Medical procedure safety guide on colonoscopies and colorectal cancer
- [How Fast Does Colon Cancer Grow and Progress?](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/how-quickly-do-colon-polyps-turn-cancerous): Cancer screening guide on colon cancer progression and early detection
- [Foods That May Lower Colon Cancer Risk](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/the-best-diet-to-lower-your-colon-cancer-risk-2): Nutrition guide on colon cancer prevention through diet and lifestyle
- [Should You Try an At-Home Colon Cancer Test?](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/at-home-colon-cancer-test): Cancer screening comparison of at-home tests versus colonoscopy

## Nutrition & Wellness

- [Nutrition - Cleveland Clinic](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/diet-food-fitness/nutrition): Evidence-based nutrition guide covering diet advice and healthy eating
- [Heart-Healthy Foods You Should Be Eating](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/heart-healthy-foods): Nutrition guide on heart-healthy foods and cardiovascular disease prevention

## Symptom Guides & Comparisons

- [Panic Attack vs. Anxiety Attack Explained](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/panic-attack-vs-anxiety-attack): Clinical explanation comparing panic attacks and anxiety attacks by PsyD
- [Pink Eye vs. Allergies: What Do You Have?](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/pink-eye-vs-allergies): Symptom comparison guide distinguishing pink eye from allergies
- [Can Allergies Cause a Sore Throat?](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/allergies-cause-sore-throat): Article on allergy-related sore throat and relief treatment options
- [Best Sore Throat Remedies for Fast Recovery](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/sore-throat-remedies-that-actually-work): Home remedies guide for sore throat treatment and symptom management

## Optional

- [How To Get Rid of Cellulite](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/hate-your-cellulite-how-to-avoid-or-minimize-it): Dermatology article on cellulite treatment and lifestyle remedies
- [Cleveland Clinic Health Essentials](https://health.clevelandclinic.org): Homepage providing health and wellness information from Cleveland Clinic experts
- [Contact Us – Cleveland Clinic](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/contact-us): Contact information and support for Health Essentials inquiries
